description: This file contains functions for configuring and retrieving user-defined field selectors in the RTL8367C switch hardware. It includes functions to set and get field selector parameters via register access, along with relevant constants and licensing information.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 format,rtk_uint32 offset)
methods.description: Configures a user-defined field selector in the hardware based on index, format, and offset.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicFieldSelector(rtk_uint32 index,rtk_uint32 * pFormat,rtk_uint32 * pOffset)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a specified field selector from the hardware.
